**Domain**: TCC

## Definition
A Software-Defined Infrastructure (SDI) architecture that supports multiple network modalities (e.g., different protocols or data types) within a unified programmable substrate. This enables flexible, topology-aware resource allocation in TCC, allowing the network to adapt to diverse computational and communication patterns.
